description: This file defines the SessionCookieJar class, which manages cookies persisted in a client session. It extends functionality from CookieJar to load and save session cookies using PHP sessions, providing methods for saving cookies upon destruction and loading cookies during initialization.

classes.name: SessionCookieJar
classes.description: A class that persists cookies in the client's PHP session, allowing session cookies to survive across requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the session cookie jar with a session key and a flag indicating whether to store session cookies. It calls the parent constructor and loads existing session cookies from PHP session storage.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Automatically saves cookies to the session when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Serializes current cookies that should be persisted into JSON and stores them in the PHP $_SESSION superglobal.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Deserializes cookies from the session storage, reconstructing cookie objects, and adding them to the jar. Throws an exception if data is invalid.
